purpose: Explicitly align native-frequency states for edge testing without rewriting source observations

daily_to_monthly.requires: separate aggregation contract preserving event counts and timing

publication_time: must be retained separately from observation_time when available
edge_lag_definition: lag measured from source-state observation time to target-state observation time; no midpoint substitution
right_censoring: recorded as unresolved or not_testable, never imputed
coverage_incomplete: edge-specific complete-case only; retain excluded records and reason
validation: emit alignment audit with counts, start/end, frequency, dropped records, and hashes
